mapper.select: SELECT e.*, c.category_name FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_category c ON e.category_id = c.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment (equipment_no, name, category_id, brand, model, serial_number, location, responsible_person, quantity, available_quantity, status, cover_image, detail_images, remark) VALUES (#{equipmentNo}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{brand}, #{model}, #{serialNumber}, #{location}, #{responsiblePerson}, #{quantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{status}, #{coverImage}, #{detailImages}, #{remark})
